compare.title: Compare models
compare.lede: Two to four repos side by side: what they weigh, what runs them, and how much attention they are getting.
compare.pasteHint: Repo id, slug or Hugging Face URL — owner/model is enough.
compare.emptyBody: Paste a repo id, or start from a pair below. Every address form works: the repo id, the feed's slug, or a Hugging Face URL.
compare.capReached: Four models fit one sheet. Remove one to add another.
compare.addNotFound: “{value}” is not in this snapshot — check the repo id.
compare.rejected: {count} of {total} addresses are not in this snapshot: {list}
compare.oneModel: One model selected — add a second to see the differences.
compare.caption: Comparison of {count} models
compare.hintRate: Cumulative downloads ÷ days since this radar first saw the repo — not growth since a previous snapshot.
compare.hintVram: Estimated from params and quantization; the glossary defines it.
compare.hintVramPerB: VRAM estimate ÷ parameters in billions — the memory each billion params costs.
compare.hintLikesPerK: Likes per 1,000 downloads — engagement, not volume.
compare.hintQuantizations: File-level quantizations found in the repo; four are shown.
compare.hintGate: The feed's quality gate: downloads, likes, a curated org or a sample widget.
compare.hintFirstSeen: First sighting by this radar, not the repo's creation date.
compare.topDifferencesNote: Against the first column, where both models report a number.
compare.howToRead: How to read this sheet: ↑ higher is better, ↓ lower is better, · no direction. “best” marks the extreme printed value among the models that report it, and every tie is marked. Deltas are against the first column. A dash means the snapshot has no value for that model — the number is unknown, not zero.
compare.metaDescription: Compare open-weight models side by side: weights, runners, licence, downloads and momentum from the last 7 days.
compare.metaDescriptionModels: {names} — side by side in the OpenWeight Radar comparison sheet.
empty.hintFilters: The filters are probably too narrow: widen the window, or let the quality gate show everything.
empty.hintNews: Nothing in this window — widen it to look further back.
empty.compareHint: Add models from a cards Compare link, or put two repo ids in the address: ?ids=owner/model,owner/model
empty.notFoundHint: It is not in the current snapshot, so it has probably left the window.
data.updated: Data refreshed {when} ago from Hugging Face.
common.savedReplaced: Replaced the filter with that name
common.savedFiltersHint: Name the current filters to keep them, or open one from the list.
common.noSavedFilters: No saved filters. Save the current one above.
pulse.hotHint: by downloads in the active window
stats.noHistory: No daily history in this window.
stats.lede: What the radar tracks, what the gate keeps, and when it was all created.
stats.categoriesNote: Models first seen by Radar inside the window, with the gate applied. A label opens that category's feed. Median over models with downloads above zero.
stats.shareNote: Share of the models in view.
stats.cadenceNote: Hugging Face repository creation date (createdAt) — not our first sighting. Bars split by whether the repo passes the gate today.
stats.gateNote: Passes at {downloads}+ downloads or {likes}+ likes (or a curated org / sample widget: {rare} today). {gated} gated repos never enter the feed.
stats.runnersNote: A runner tag is present on {share} of the models in view; a model can carry several.
stats.wireNote: News publishedAt, split by kind; the wire is refreshed every 10 minutes.
stats.methodBody: Snapshot {when} · cache 15 min · “tracked” = first seen by Radar (since {since}) · “created” = Hugging Face repository date. Counts use the window and gate above unless a panel says otherwise. The snapshot keeps no download history, so the page prints no in-window growth.
stats.gateForced: “Show everything” is limited to 30 days, so this page is showing gate-passed rows only.
detail.calcManual: no stored parameter count — enter one
detail.aboutNote: excerpt of the Hugging Face model card
detail.mentionsNote: linked news and distinctive name matches
